services.name: Semi-Private Personal Training
services.desc: Capped at 6 people, it’s not exactly personal training and not exactly a small group class. You’ll have the perfect balance of 1-on-1, personalized workouts and coaching with with the benefits of the energy, inspiration, and comradery of committed training partners who all the same goals - willing to work hard to improve our lives. Following MovementLink’s Cross-Training blueprint, Coach Justin will be your personal coach, there to motivate, teach you technique, and customize the exercises, reps, and intensity of your workouts specifically for your fitness level and your goals, ensuring you get the optimal stimulus to generate the best possible results every session. services.name: New to CrossFit
services.desc: With your previous CrossFit experience, you have the option of just jumping into a free class or coming to an intro session to chat about your goals, talk about the gym, and do a quick workout with us. We are CrossFitters ourselves and understand that one interaction is likely not enough to make your choice. While on your trial week, come to unlimited classes, get to know the coaches, and see our perfect blend of being laid back, but knowing when it’s time to work hard. With our memberships, you can cancel anytime for any reason and we’ll even freeze your account for free if you are traveling!
